title: hippocrepis scabra subsp. commutata
intro: Hippocrepis scabra subsp. commutata, commonly known as the rough milk-vetch, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hippocrepis scabra subsp. commutata include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic properties.
